title: Mitsui Shopping Park says members' personal data leaked after unauthorized access to its app, ITmedia reports
date_note: 26 November is the day the companies disclosed the number of affected members, per ITmedia; unauthorized access was confirmed on 18 November.
geo_basis: Japan, as the companies and publisher are Japanese; no city stated
summary: ITmedia NEWS reports that Mitsui Fudosan and Mitsui Fudosan Commercial Management confirmed unauthorized access to the Mitsui Shopping Park app on 18 November. On 26 November they said 3.12 million (約312万, i.e. about) point-program members were affected, with names, dates of birth, addresses, email addresses, phone numbers, gender and member numbers leaked. They said credit card information and passwords were not included.
plain: Japanese mall operators say 3.12 million (約312万, i.e. about) members of the Mitsui Shopping Park point program had personal details leaked after unauthorized access to the app. They say card data and passwords were not included.
exec: The companies say 3.12 million (約312万, i.e. about) members' personal details were leaked; they say card data and passwords were not included.
action: No action needed; for awareness. The companies say they will contact affected members individually, such as by email.
attack: unauthorized access to a mobile app

evidence.quote: 三井ショッピングパーク、約312万会員の個人情報漏えい アプリに不正アクセス

validation.note: One publisher (ITmedia NEWS) relaying the companies' announcement; the companies' own notice was not found by search and not read.
